title: Lucasta
author: Richard Lovelace
description: "Lucasta" by Richard Lovelace is a collection of poetry published in the mid-17th century, specifically in 1649.
longDescription: The book is notable for its exploration of themes related to love, virtue, and the complexities of human emotion, with a central focus on the eponymous character, Lucasta, who embodies beauty and chaste love.

authorInfo.bio: Richard Lovelace (1618–1658) wrote Lucasta. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
